title: Caliburn G3 Kit
description:
UWELL CALIBURN G3 POD KIT

The UWELL CALIBURN G3 POD KIT is a low-maintenance vape that is ideal for beginners and experienced vapers alike. It’s 900mAh built-in battery will provide enough charge for long vaping sessions and the 5-25W output is ideal for RDTL (Restricted Direct To Lung) and MTL (Mouth To Lung) vaping. This kit is compatible with the UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD and two are included to get you started. The UWELL CALIBURN G3 POD KIT features a single button, making it easy to set up and vape. In addition, this is the first pod system among the Caliburn G series featuring an OLED display. Precise power adjustment, puff recording, and trigger lock mode help to customize vaping journey for users via the large trigger button.

Features：

- Dual Airflow System

- 2A Fast Charging

- Pro-FOCS Flavor Technology

- Wider ClearView

- 2mL E-liquid capacity

Parameters：

- Materials: Aluminum Alloy + PCTG

- Net Weight: 47 g

- Dimensions: 115.5 mm * 24 mm * 13.9 mm

- Output Power: Maximum 25 W

- Battery Capacity: 900 mAh built-in battery

- Capacity: 2ml

Includes:
1 x UWELL CALIBURN G3 POD KIT
1 x UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD-0.6OHM
1 x UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD-0.9OHM
1 x Type-C Charging Cable
1 x Lanyard
1 x User’s Manual
